correctness.rationale: For every q in odd characteristic at least five and all 11 S6 cycle types, elementary matching multiplicity gives only 1,2,3,6. Intersections of the fifteen matching planes are graph-sign linear spaces; their ranks equal numbers of bipartite components. Frobenius saturation and Galois descent give exact counts of each intersection, and binomial inversion gives all 44 polynomial entries. An executable full 32767-subset symbolic enumeration asserts each entry. An independent direct finite-field enumeration verifies five nontrivial classes, but finite examples are not the infinite-field proof. The five-cycle orbit-length obstruction independently implies rational emptiness and its zeta function.

value.rationale: The union of all fifteen planes is a canonical intrinsic two-dimensional boundary of the Segre cubic. Classifying every finite-field twist and exact local geometric plane multiplicity gives complete arithmetic strata, fields of definition, and all extension counts. The five-cycle form has no rational boundary point despite the ambient cubic having rational points, a geometrically motivated arithmetic obstruction, not an arbitrary small census. The result adds information not implied merely by whole-threefold or node/flag tables.
